sahneler.metin: Reactor four at Chernobyl exploded during a safety test.
Within seconds, power surged and a steam blast tore off the roof.
The strangest part is what triggered it.
Operators pressed the emergency shutdown button.
But the control rods had graphite tips.
Entering the core, those tips first pushed power up, not down.
In an unstable reactor, that spike was enough.
These reactors were later changed so shutdown can never add power.
